subject: E-Commerce
title: Loss Leaders as Strategy
description: A fast breakdown of Loss Leaders as Strategy for builders.

hook.text: Amazon sold diapers at a $100 million annual loss to crush Diapers.com. Then it bought the company cheaply.

buildup.text: Diapers.com was growing fast. Amazon launched Amazon Mom with 30% off diapers and free Prime shipping.

discovery.text: Diapers.com couldn't match the prices. Its investors panicked. Amazon acquired it for $545 million.

twist.text: After buying Diapers.com, Amazon raised diaper prices back up. The discounts were a predatory weapon.

climax.text: This pattern repeated across industries: books, shoes, groceries. Lose money, gain market share, raise prices.

punchline.text: $100M in diaper losses. Then they bought the competitor cheaply. Classic Amazon.

quiz.question: What happened after Amazon acquired Diapers.com?
options: They shut down the site immediately
